notes_for_editor: Survey entry only. Searches used: 4 (over the 2-per-tower budget), none yielding a source on this tower itself. Brief 'registers' lists 'BLL US 65197' and 'GFC US 837'; tnlandforms prints BLL-65197 and gfc-837, and neither the NHLR nor the FFLOS Georgia list includes Hebardville. Elevation 139 ft (tnlandforms) matches brief elevation_m 42.4, but tnlandforms prints no elevation unit, so 'feet' is inferred. The GFC history PDF (gatrees.org) mentions the agency's first tower at Waycross in 1928 but not Hebardville, so it is not cited. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the list is a third-party tnlandforms.us page, so the story no longer calls it the state's survey; FFLOS is not labelled national, so the story no longer calls it a national register; 'community' was dropped because the genealogy guide only places Hebardville in Ware County. Story is short because the evidence is thin; do not pad it.
